Step: 1052 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception because 1052 mod 100 ≠ 0).  
Days from Apr 24 to end of year:  
Apr: 30-24 = 6 days left in April.  
May-Dec: 31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 245 days.  
Total = 6 + 245 = 251 days left in 1052.  
219 days added: first 251 days use up 219 days within 1052, so no overflow to 1053.  
219 days after Apr 24: Apr 24 + 219 days = Apr 24 + (6 days to Apr 30) + 213 more days.  
213 days from May 1: May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31 = 31+30+31+31+30+31 = 184 days (end Oct 31). Remainder: 213-184=29 days into November → Nov 29, 1052.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1052-11-29
